info.name: The Lost Piece of the VIP Ticket

descriptions.notStarted: Where did the ripped piece of the VIP ticket go? I better go see Kevin the Soldier.

descriptions.completed: Fortunately, even after losing a ripped piece of VIP ticket, Kevin the Soldier was picking up after me. Phew... thanks a lot =)
